Description:
This is your chance to have it all! Centre stage in the Yaletown Marina/ Beach Crescent neighbourhood at the Waterford, the essence of living well. This highly sought after 06 floor plan with southern exposure enjoys sweeping views of the city, Granville Island & False Creek.

Enjoying the spacious open kitchen/dining/living areas, The den is perfect for an office, in-suite storage/pantry room, two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The home exquisitely finished with Hardwood flooring in all living areas, carpets in both bedrooms, double edged granite to stainless steel appliances.

Floor to ceiling glass walls celebrate the natural environment. Features include 24 hour concierge, over-height ceilings, granite & corian countertops, Family size appliances, AC , custom crafted wood cabinets & quality finishing throughout.

As a resident at Waterford, you get to enjoy membership at Club Viva, a resort-style facility that includes lap pool, theatre, spa, squash courts and much more.

Minutes walking distance to Yaletown Roundhouse station, best restaurants in the city, the sea wall, and a dog park is just at your front steps.

Comes with 1 parking stall, no additional storage locker.
